_source: Built 2026-10-23 from the real site: the 6 live pages in real-inventory.json plus the 14 products in the live catalog-data.js. Replaces the sitemap-era clusters, now in data/retired/.
_owner_rule: canonical_owner is set only by an Owner decision, recorded in decisions_made with its date. A null owner makes the cluster a HOLD for any new package. Setting one is never a code change.
_owner_status: All seven owners were set by the Owner on 2026-11-13 (D-09, D-10, D-11). Every owner URL is PLANNED: the page is built in acs-site/ and is not deployed. On the live site these addresses do not exist yet, so a package may be written against an owner but nothing may link to it until the rebuild is live.

decisions_made.question: Do category pages exist as their own URLs, or is the filtered catalogue (/products.html?category=X) the canonical home for each category head term?
decisions_made.decision: Six category pages, one per category, at /categories/<id>/. Each owns its category's head term. They are generated from the catalogue and state nothing the catalogue does not.

decisions_made.question: Three ribbon products (wax, wax-resin, resin) will all target the same intent, 'ริบบอน / thermal transfer ribbon'. Do they get three pages with one owning the head term, or one page covering the choice between them?
decisions_made.decision: The ribbon category page (/categories/ribbons/) owns the head term and sets the three kinds side by side. The three product pages stay; each owns only its own kind (wax, wax-resin, resin).

decisions_made.question: Where does the approved about-ACS copy live, now that /why-acs returns 404?
decisions_made.decision: /about/. The old address /why-acs and the earlier build's /company both answer 301 to it.
